title: Study in Germany
summary: Germany has many public universities with low or no tuition for several programmes, but living costs and state rules differ. Many courses are in German; some masters courses are in English.

opportunities: Post-study work options, subject to each country's current rules

title: Study in the USA
summary: The USA has a very wide range of universities and courses. Costs are high, but many universities give scholarships and assistantships, especially for master's and PhD students.
qualification: A recognised qualification and, depending on the programme, tests such as the TOEFL or IELTS and (for some courses) other tests. Check each university's rules.
courses: Bachelor's, master's and PhD programmes (availability varies by university)

entrance_exams.name: Other tests only if the programme asks

opportunities: Post-study work options, subject to each country's current rules
next_steps: Shortlist universities and check the funding offered.
